title: The Iceblade Sorcerer Shall Rule the World Author Nana Mikoshiba's Original Novel Gets Manga Adaptation on November 17
content:
The official X (formerly Twitter ) account of Kodansha 's Magazine Pocket app announced on Tuesday a manga adaptation of Nana Mikoshiba 's Kasō Slum de Garakuta o Shūri Shiteita Tensei-sha wa Arayuru Majutsu o shi, Sekai Saikō no Majutsu-shi he to Itaru ~Genten Majutsu no Sōzō-sha~ (A Reincarnated Person Repairing Junk in the Slums Learns to "Recreate" Every Kind of Magic, and Becomes the World's Greatest Mage ~Creator of Original Magic) novel, which will launch on November 17. Meguru Kanadome is drawing the manga, and Akari is credited for original character designs.

Mikoshiba launched the story on the Kakuyomu website in June 2025. The story centers on Allen, who gets reincarnated and lives in the slum outskirts of a magical world. He survives by scavenging, selling, and repairing broken magical artifacts. Unknowingly, by repairing magical artifacts, Allen learns the very essence of magic. He eventually becomes known as "the greatest genius mage in history." But with Allen at the center of magic, the abyss of magic begins to open.

Mikoshiba's The Iceblade Sorcerer Shall Rule the World ( Hyōken no Majutsushi ga Sekai wo Suberu - Sekai Saikyō no Majutsushi de Aru Shōnen wa, Majutsu Gakuin ga Nyūgaku Suru ) original story launched on the Shōsetsuka ni Narō (Let's Become Novelists) website in October 2019, and ended in February 2022. The light novel series launched in July 2020, with illustrations by Riko Korie . Kodansha publishes the light novels in print in Japan. The light novels' 10th volume will ship on December 2, and its listing teases a story finale.

Norihito Sasaki 's manga adaptation launched in Kodansha 's Magazine Pocket website in June 2020, and ended in January 2024. The manga's 16th and final compiled book volume shipped in April 2024. Kodansha USA Publishing released the 13th volume in English on June 2.

A Hyōken no Majutsushi ga Sekai wo Suberu II : Sekai Saikyō no Majutsushi de Aru Shōnen wa, Majutsu Gakuin ga Nyūgaku Suru sequel manga launched on May 27. Nao Kagami illustrates the manga and Ishiya Ōgane is in charge of composition. Niconico Manga publishes the manga under Kodansha 's " Suiyōbi no Sirius " label. The first volume shipped on October 8.

The first season of the novels' television anime adaptation premiered in January 2023. Crunchyroll streamed the anime as it aired in Japan, and also streamed an English dub . The second season of the anime premiered on October 8, and is currently ongoing. Crunchyroll is streaming the anime as it airs and is also streaming an English dub .

title: Yu-Gi-Oh! Tag Force GX Game Previews Duels, Partners, Multiplayer, Exploration in New Trailer
content:
Konami streamed a new gameplay trailer for its Yu-Gi-Oh! Tag Force GX game , an updated version of the 2008 Yu-Gi-Oh! GX Tag Force 3 game, on Tuesday. The trailer previews the duels, partner system, online multiplayer, and town exploration gameplay.

The new version features modern visuals, voice acting, and enhanced Dueling and Tag Dueling with over 3,800 cards. The physical editions for Switch 2 and Switch include three physical Yu-Gi-Oh! Trading Card Game cards: Yubel, Wicked Canon, and Hope for the Future. Preorders for the digital Switch 2 and Switch 2 editions include the same digital cards as well as a Winged Kuriboh Duel Mate for the Yu-Gi-Oh! Master Duel game.

Yu-Gi-Oh! GX Tag Force 3 debuted for PlayStation Portable in Japan in November 2008. The game got releases in Europe and Australia, but not in North America. The Yu-Gi-Oh! GX Tag Force and Yu-Gi-Oh! GX Tag Force 2 games launched for PSP in 2006 and 2007, respectively, and received releases in North America.

The Yu-Gi-Oh! GX anime series premiered in 2004. Cartoon Network began airing the series in 2005, followed by 4Kids TV in 2007, both dubbed in English. Crunchyroll added the anime's first season in August 2015, and also offers its English-dubbed version. The company later added the fourth season in Japanese with English subtitles. The anime is also streaming on other services including Hulu , Disney+ , Amazon Prime Video , and Tubi .

Yu-Gi-Oh! Duel Monster GX 20th Remaster , a remastered version of the anime, began airing on TV Tokyo in April 2025 to commemorate the anime's 20th anniversary.

title: Dragon Ball Still Has More to Explore With Raditz & The Saiyan Needs a Chance
content:
Redemption is a hallmark of the Dragon Ball franchise, and so many capitalized on their second chances with Raditz being no different. The brother of Goku and the son of Bardock came to Earth with destruction in mind alongside fellow Saiyans, Vegeta and Nappa. His introduction in Dragon Ball Z gave everyone a small glimpse into the ruthless, bloodthirsty Saiyan , but outside of that and a brief cameo in Dragon Ball Super: Broly , there hasn’t been much else canon-wise.

Raditz did get his second appearance in the franchise in Super Dragon Ball Heroes . This Raditz is a multiverse version that never obviously never experienced the events of Z or he’d be non existent. Goku’s brother clearly stepped up his game in this appearance as he turned into a Super Saiyan 3 in his battle with Turles . He’s ultimately defeated, and his particular timeline is eliminated for failing to advance in the Super Space-Time Tournament. It’s a quick but fun cameo for Raditz, but it doesn’t have to be the end either.

Dragon Ball Should Embrace Extra Raditz Storylines

The interesting Raditz arc starts with the aforementioned multiverse. An evil Saiyan turned good is the route that a few original villains/anti-heroes get in the Dragon Ball world like Vegeta, Broly, Bardock, and more. Bardock and Broly gave fans a mostly evil first impression in non-canon material before being brought in as good, canon characters in the recent Dragon Ball Super: Broly film. Raditz is the opposite of those two, however, as he started off evil in the official timeline. But he could take a similar route in another “what if” Dragon Ball world, just like his father did in the Xenoverse .

The multiverse already unveiled one iteration of him in Super Dragon Ball Heroes . There are surely other forms out there, and like Future Trunks, he could be brought into the canon or stay a fun non-canon entity that exists alongside the Evil Saiyan Cumber and the original version of Broly . He showed almost no compassion in his official form. Maybe the newest one can learn from his past mistakes? In fact, the only moment of any true caring that we get from the original Raditz was seeing his surprise when Goku was willing to sacrifice himself in order to defeat him.

Maybe this new Raditz either finds a way to survive the blast or is wished back somehow and changes his ways? He then might leave the Frieza Force and take Goku’s route. It’s clear that other versions were able to obtain some immense power, so he could turn into quite the formidable ally for the Z Fighters if given the chance.

Dragon Ball Continues To Open All Possibilities

This run of recent content for Dragon Ball has a lot of fan service, but it’s also what a lot people are asking for. For a long time, Dragon Ball was extremely selective in what it decided to focus on. The video games allowed fans to dream up all sorts of scenarios, but few came to fruition or were uncanonized. Akira Toriyama created a fantastic series, and he leaned into some of those non-canon stories in Dragon Ball Daima .

Furthermore, Dragon Ball Super and Super Dragon Ball Heroes were products of listening to the fans. They didn’t need to make everything official either. With the latter, they didn’t need a fully thought-out plo t to bring back lots of past Saiyans and variants of others. They just opened the door to more ideas. Raditz might get the next run or Cumber, but the point is that there’s more to explore in the coming years with the franchise. Would you like to see the return of Goku’s brother in a new form? Let us know in the comments.

title: WEBTOON Reports US$9.23 Million in 3rd Quarter of 2026
content:
The company's net loss shrank to US$7.5 million from US$11.1 million a year earlier. WEBTOON said that the improvement came from higher gross profit and an income tax benefit, partially offset by heavier marketing spending and bigger foreign currency losses. Quarterly revenue came in at US$362.8 million, down 4.0% year-over-year.

Advertising was the standout, with advertising revenue jumping 26.2% to US$49.7 million. Paid content, the company's largest business, slipped 3.9% to US$275.5 million, and IP adaptations revenue fell 27.5% to US$37.6 million. The company again blamed the weak Korean won and Japanese yen for the revenue decline. Adjusting for currency fluctuations, revenue grew 0.2%, with paid content in Korea up 23.7%.

Korea and Japan moved in opposite directions. In Korea, monthly active users rose about 4% to 25.6 million, and paying users grew 5.2% to 3.9 million. Average monthly spending per paying user rose 17.6% to US$9.4, lifting Korean revenue 10.8% to US$169.3 million. Japan, WEBTOON 's largest market by revenue, struggled. Monthly active users fell 12.1% to 22.3 million, and paying users dropped 12.9% to 2.0 million. Average spending per paying user slipped 5.8% to US$22.3, and Japanese revenue fell 18% to US$147.3 million. In the rest of the world, active users grew to 111.7 million, but paying users fell 8.0% to 1.6 million. Across all markets, the company counts about 159 million monthly active users. WEBTOON said it will focus on a Japan recovery. President Yongsoo Kim told investors on the earnings call that Japan remains one of the company's biggest growth opportunities, and said WEBTOON plans to invest 10 billion yen (about US$63 million) in Japanese content over the next three years to strengthen its local pipeline.

Kim also pointed to IP expansion and a new app as growth drivers. He cited Remarried Empress, now a live-action series on Disney+ , as a successful example of a story moving from web novel to webcomic, drama and, soon, animation. North American webcomic Mafia Nanny is in development as a Hulu series. A Marvel app, built in collaboration with Disney, launches on November 16 and will gather about 35,000 titles from Marvel, Star Wars , and 20th Century Studios.

For the fourth quarter, WEBTOON expects currency-adjusted revenue growth of 9.0%–12.0%, or US$371–381 million at current exchange rates. That outlook includes revenue from RI Games Holdings Inc., the game developer WEBTOON is investing in, once the second closing of that deal is completed. Founder and CEO Junkoo Kim said the company continued to invest for growth in the third quarter and expects to return to double-digit revenue growth in the fourth.

title: HIDIVE to Release Made in Abyss: Awakening Mystery Film in 2027 With N. American Premiere Screening at Anime Frontier on December 5
content:
HIDIVE announced on Tuesday that it will distribute Made in Abyss : Awakening Mystery ( Made in Abyss: Mezameru Shinpi ), the first film in the new Made in Abyss anime film series , in 2027. HIDIVE also revealed that it will screen the film's North American premiere on December 5 at this year's Anime Frontier event in Fort Worth, TX. The company streamed an English-subtitled trailer:

The new cast members include:

• Sumire Morohoshi as Tepaste

• Takanori Hoshino as Cravagli

• Nana Mizuki as Srajo

• Akeno Watanabe as Nishagora

• Shunsuke Takeuchi as Yataramar

• Nao Tōyama as Sherumi

• Yume Miyamoto as Menae

The returning cast members include:

• Mariya Ise as Reg

• Miyu Tomita as Riko

• Shiori Izawa as Nanachi

• Misaki Kuno as Faputa

Masayuki Kojima ( Black Bullet , Tibetan Dog ) returned to direct the anime at the studio Kinema Citrus ( My Happy Marriage , The Rising of The Shield Hero ). Hideyuki Kurata ( Samurai Flamenco , The World God Only Knows ) was again in charge of scripts, and Kazuchika Kise ( Ghost in the Shell: Arise Alternative Architecture , xxxHOLiC ) and Yuka Kuroda ( Made in Abyss: The Golden City of the Scorching Sun ) returned as character designers.

Additional staff members include:

• Design Leader: Takeshi Takakura

• Art Directors: Osamu Masuyama, Teru Sekiguchi, Asaki Nakamura (Inspired)

• Color Key Artist: Miyao Yamashita

• Compositing Director of Photography: Tsunetaka Ema (T2 Studio)

• Editing: Masayuki Kurosawa

• Sound Director: Haru Yamada

• Sound Effects: Tōru Noguchi

• Music: Kevin Penkin

• Music Producer: Hiromitsu Iijima

• Music Production: IRMA LA DOUCE

• Music Production Collaboration: Kadokawa

The series' composer Kevin Penkin feat. Mori Calliope perform the film's theme song "Chain of the Abyss."

The second film in the series has been greenlit .

Kadokawa announced in January 2023 a sequel to the Made in Abyss: The Golden City of the Scorching Sun ( Made in Abyss: Retsujitsu no Ōgonkyō ) anime.

The first 13-episode television anime series of Made in Abyss premiered in Japan in July 2017. Sentai Filmworks licensed the series and released it on Blu-ray Disc in October 2018. The English-subtitled version of the show streamed in the United States on Amazon 's Anime Strike service, and HIDIVE streamed the series outside of the United States.

Made in Abyss: The Golden City of the Scorching Sun ( Made in Abyss: Retsujitsu no Ōgonkyō ) was the second season based on Akihito Tsukushi 's Made in Abyss manga. It premiered in July 2022 and ended with a one-hour finale in September 2022. HIDIVE streamed the series as it aired in Japan. Sentai Filmworks licensed the second season for release on digital and home video.

The Made in Abyss: Dawn of the Deep Soul anime film opened in Japan in January 2020, and ranked at #9 in its opening weekend, earning 102,284,000 yen (about US$929,300) in its first three days. The anime film received 4DX and MX4D screenings. Sentai Filmworks premiered the movie in select theaters in the U.S. and Canada in August 2020. The film was scheduled to premiere in the U.S. in April 2020, but it was delayed due to COVID-19. Sentai Filmworks again screened the film in September 2020.

The first compilation film for the anime, Made in Abyss: Journey's Dawn ( Made in Abyss : Tabidachi no Yoake ), opened in Japan in January 2019, followed by the second film, Made in Abyss: Wandering Twilight ( Made in Abyss: Hōrō Suru Tasogare ), two weeks later. Sentai Filmworks premiered the first film in Los Angeles in March 2019, before it opened in theaters later that month. Sentai Filmworks premiered the second film in Rosemont, Illinois in May 2019, before it opened in theaters in the United States later that month. Both compilation films are streaming on HIDIVE .

In the story of Made in Abyss , an enormous pit and cave system called the "Abyss" is the only unexplored place in the world. Strange and wonderful creatures reside in its depths, and it is full of precious relics that current humans are unable to make. The mysteries of the Abyss fascinate humans, and they head down to explore. The adventurers who venture into pit are known as "Cave Raiders." A little orphan girl named Riko lives in the town of Ōrth on the edge of the Abyss. Her dream is to become a Cave Raider like her mother and solve the mysteries of the cave system. One day, Riko starts exploring the caves and discovers a robot who resembles a human boy.

title: Avatar: Seven Havens Is Avoiding The Legend of Korra’s Biggest Mistake
content:
Avatar: Seven Havens has wrapped up the first season of its run with Paramount+, and the producers behind it all have revealed how the series is set to avoid The Legend of Korra ‘s biggest mistake thanks to having a full plan laid out in mind. Avatar: Seven Havens has introduced Pavi’s path for the future with its finale as she now needs to unlock all seven of her chakras and explore the other six Havens. It’s a story that’s set to be told through four seasons now in production .

Avatar: Seven Havens has been confirmed through to Season 4 when it’s all said and done , and producers Michael DiMartino and Sehaj Sethi confirmed that these four seasons will entirely wrap the story. But in speaking with GamesRadar+ , it’s been revealed by DiMartino that production on this new series is already avoiding The Legend of Korra’s biggest obstacle as it’s laid out with a four season plan in mind rather than coming up with it on the fly with each new season by comparison.

Avatar: Seven Havens Is Being Planned Across Multiple Seasons

“This one was designed more with a clear end, kind of the way we did with Avatar[: The Last Airbender], where we had pitched the whole story out,” DiMartino stated. When comparing Avatar: Seven Havens’ production to The Legend of Korra ‘s , the franchise co-creator explains how the team has a better plan of attack this time around. “Then when we did Korra, we only thought we were going to do one season, so we designed it a little differently, so if that’s all there was, it was a good little one-season story, but then we had the opportunity to do more.”

But as DiMartino explained, when the team came back to Avatar Studios to develop more projects, they gravitated toward multi-season stories, “When we came back to do the movie [Avatar: Aang] and these shows, we went back to what we’re naturally drawn to, which is this big epic story [told] over multiple seasons. So that’s our goal.” But working towards this endpoint in mind has already set a more clear path for Avatar: Seven Havens to follow compared to its more built season by season predecessor.

What Does This Mean for Avatar: Seven Havens ‘ Future?

“This is a thing [DiMartino and Konietzko] have always done, and I really agree with, is finding your story, finding your endpoint, and always working towards that,” producer Sehaj Sethi elaborated on further. “So whether or not they gave us the seasons, we knew where we were going, and we weren’t going to adjust that depending on whether or not they gave us one, two, or four seasons.” Which also likely means set developments fans can look forward to seeing with each new season as they arrive.

Avatar: Seven Havens is currently in the works on Books 2-4 of the animated series, with Book Two confirmed for another set of 13 episodes. It has yet to confirm its release date with Paramount+ as of this time, but the producers have teased some of the big developments coming in the new season like seeing more of Korra and Asami’s future after The Legend of Korra .

How are you liking Avatar: Seven Havens compared to The Legend of Korra after its debut season? What are you hoping to see before it all ends?

HT – GamesRadar+

title: After 5 Years, Dandadan Finally Reveals Okarun’s Tragic Origin Story
content:
DAN DA DAN has been working its way through one of its most divisive arcs for the past few months, and it has all led to the reveal of Okarun’s truly heartbreaking origin story after five long years. Yukinobu Tatsu’s original manga series has blown to a whole new level of popularity in the last few years thanks to the success of its TV anime adaptation , but it really hasn’t been the same for the manga. Fans really have been debating its quality for the past year’s worth of chapters.

DAN DA DAN has been in a rather chaotic arc as many new foes with strange powers of their own have started attacking Okarun and the others in order to steal their abilities. Okarun himself has been without Turbo Granny’s power for quite some time, and that has led to him nearly transforming into a deadly oni thanks to a secret dark plan. But the newest chapter of the series really digs into his rage and reveals just how terrible his life was before Momo Ayase came into his life.

DAN DA DAN Chapter 252 Reveals Okarun’s Heartbreaking Past

DAN DA DAN has never been shy about the fact that Okarun had been troubled and lonely before crossing paths with Momo in the earliest chapters, but Chapter 252 is the first real time the series actually dives into his past. Titled “Ken Takakura,” it’s revealed that his mother had separated from his father while he was very young. Okarun was given the choice to live with his mother and her new family, but he realized that it wasn’t what his mother wanted at all as she blissfully left the young boy behind. Then he spent most of his time alone.

He spent most of his young life alone, and was bullied every day by the other kids. And when his father was around, his own depressing circumstances led him to taking it out on Okarun. The young boy had been abused both at home and school, and only found refuge in a sudden magazine about aliens that gave him something to look forward to. He was hoping to make friends with aliens because he felt that was the only way he’d survive, and was at the point where he wanted to harm himself or others. But that was until Momo came along and changed everything as seen in the series’ earliest chapters.

What Does This Mean for Okarun’s Future?

With the reveal of Okarun’s backstory, it’s all part of an effort to save him from the oni influence steadily taking over his body. It had been planted there as a way to eventually draw out an apparent latent aspect of Turbo Granny’s power when it disappeared, but now that doesn’t seem to be the case. But also it’s an image of Turbo Granny seemingly helping Okarun get back himself after going berserk. It’s just a matter of whether or not he can truly overcome his past.

As Momo is still without her memories of all the time she has spent with Okarun thus far, it’s made this all the more tragic as Okarun has been trying to keep his distance from her despite how much he loves her. But this flashback reveals it goes even deeper than that as she unknowingly saved him from a lot more than that as his life was truly messed up. But how are you feeling about this look into Okarun’s past? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments.

title: Rock Band FLOW Announce U.S. Dates for New 2027 World Tour
content:
Rock band FLOW announced last Friday U.S., Latin American, and Japanese dates for its new tour titled " FLOW WORLD TOUR 2027 "ONCE IN A CENTURY"～ ANIME THE MAX!!!" The tour features songs that FLOW have performed for anime as well as songs from ONCE IN A CENTURY , their first full original album in four years. The album refers to the number "26" (which can be read in Japanese as FLOW ), for the year 2026.

The U.S. tour dates include:

• February 11 - Big Night Live in Boston

• February 13 - The Palladium Times Square at New York City

• February 14 - The Howard Theatre in Washington D.C.

• February 16 - The Neighborhood Theatre in Charlotte, NC

• February 17 - The Masquerade/Heaven in Atlanta

• February 19 - The Beacham in Orlando

• February 20 - The Parker in Fort Lauderdale, FL

• February 22 - House of Blues New Orleans in New Orleans

• February 24 - Studio at the Factory in Dallas, TX

• February 25 - Moonline in Austin, TX

• February 26 - House of Blues Houston in Houston, TX

The band will also perform at The Parking Lot at the National Football Stadium in Manuaga, Nicaragua on February 28.

Japanese tour dates include:

• January 29 - Spotify O-West in Tokyo

• February 7 - BananaHall in Osaka

• March 11 - Electric Lady Land in Aichi

• March 13 - Yebisu Ya Pro in Okayama

• March 16 - Drum Be-1 in Fukuoka

• March 17 - Kyoto Muse in Kyoto

• April 16 - Kashiwa Palooza in Chiba

• April 23 - Sendai darwin in Miyagi

The band teased more dates to come.

The band went on its first five-continent tour " FLOW World Tour: Anime Shibari 2024-2025" from July 2024-May 2025.

The group have performed theme songs for such anime as Eureka Seven , EUREKA SEVEN AO , Code Geass: Lelouch of the Rebellion (both seasons), The Seven Deadly Sins , Naruto , Naruto Shippūden , Boruto: Naruto Next Generations , Durarara!!×2 Ketsu , Tales of Zestiria the X , Heroman , The Seven Deadly Sins: Revival of The Commandments , Samurai Flamenco , and Dragon Ball Z: Battle of Gods .

title: Exclusive: Made in Abyss: Awakening Mystery Heads to HIDIVE in 2027, North American Premiere Set for December 5
content:
HIDIVE will distribute Made in Abyss: Awakening Mystery in 2027, with the film set to have its North American premiere on December 5 at Anime Frontier in Fort Worth, Texas. Further release details will be announced at a later date.

The film premiered in Japan on October 23, 2026, and marked the first new Made in Abyss movie in six years. It continues the story following Made in Abyss: The Golden City of the Scorching Sun , the second season of the TV anime. A second film was already confirmed to be in production .

The returning cast includes:

• Miyu Tomita as Riko

• Mariya Ise as Reg

• Shiori Izawa as Nanachi

• Misaki Kuno as Faputa

• Sumire Morohoshi as Tepaste

• Takanori Hoshino as Cravagli

HIDIVE also released an English sub version of the trailer, which Anime Corner has the exclusive opportunity to share first:

Masayuki Kojima is directing the film, with Hideyuki Kurata handling the screenplay. Yuka Kuroda and Kazuchika Kise are credited with character design, while studio Kinema Citrus is handling animation production. John Ledford, President of HIDIVE, commented on the announcement:

“We’re thrilled to be bringing the highly anticipated new movie Made in Abyss: Awakening Mystery to audiences in 2027. This is a major milestone for HIDIVE and will mark a proud decade-long history as not only the international distributor of the Made in Abyss franchise but also as a streaming service — beginning in July 2017 with Made in Abyss Season 1 as one of HIDIVE’s inaugural simulcasts when it launched. Stay tuned for details on next year’s release. In the meantime, for those who haven’t experienced Made in Abyss, now is the perfect opportunity to check out the original series. It’s truly one of my personal favorites!”

Awakening Mystery follows Riko, Reg, Nanachi, and Faputa as they continue deeper into the sixth layer of the Abyss. Riko remains in search of her missing mother, the White Whistle Lyza, while returning figures and new characters become involved in the beginning of another mystery.

Made in Abyss , written and illustrated by Akihito Tsukushi, follows the descent of a girl named Riko and a robot boy named Reg into the Abyss, a massive pit filled with ancient relics and mysterious creatures. The manga is serialized on Takeshobo’s Web Comic Gamma and has over 22 million circulating copies over 15 volumes.

title: Naruto’s Live-Action Movie Gets Surprising Change Amid DC Studios Shake Up
content:
Masashi Kishimoto’s Naruto is now in the works on a new live-action movie, and it’s gotten a surprising shake up due to everything now happening with DC Studios following the Warner Bros. and Paramount merger. The recent Skydance merger came with the surprising reveal that DC Studios heads James Gunn and Peter Safran were going to be stepping down soon , and there are still lots of other elements going to be explored in the immediate fallout. As it turns out, Naruto is one of the films caught in the wake.

With Gunn and Safran stepping down, it was announced that former Marvel executive Jeremy Latcham would be taking their place as the new president and CEO of DC Studios. Latcham had a lot of other projects in the works as reported by The Hollywood Reporter , and is now working at “untangling” himself from his current works such as the new Naruto live-action movie now in development with Lionsgate and Sony Pictures . But it’s yet to be revealed how this will ultimately impact the project.

Naruto Live-Action Movie Loses Producer Ahead of Production

Naruto’ s new live-action movie is currently slated to start production in Spring 2027 with Lionsgate overseeing its domestic release and production along with Sony Pictures (who are co-financing the film) handling its worldwide launch. Latcham had been previously attached as one of the film’s producers alongside writer and directer Destin Daniel Cretton and Jeyun Munford through Hisako with Avi Arad, Ari Arad and Emmy Yu of Arad Productions. Given that the film has yet to start production it’s likely not going to result in too big of a change, but that ultimately remains to be seen.

As for what has been revealed about the new Naruto live-action movie thus far, Charles Melton has reportedly signed onto the project as Kakashi Hatake . A worldwide casting search had been launched earlier this year for Naruto Uzumaki, Sasuke Uchiha and Sakura Harada, but no official casting has been revealed as of this time. Cretton has been open about the fact that he had been working closely with original series creator Masashi Kishimoto, but it’s unclear what the loss of potential transition of one of its producers will mean for the final end result at this point.

Will This Harm Naruto’ s Live-Action Movie?

While it’s not clear how much Latcham’s influence will impact the upcoming Naruto live-action movie, it’s not likely that the project will be too impacted by the loss of a single producer. There are still many other names attached to it as it heads into development, and Lionsgate and Sony Pictures are investing in quite a lot to making it happen . It’s possible that the loss of yet another potential dissenting voice in room could even streamline the creative process for a better result. But the alternative could be just as true as well.

Destin Daniel Cretton has shared some special new messages for Naruto’ s live-action movie debut through the year thus far , and the writer/director has been open about his love of the original manga and desire to bring it to screen in a big way. There are all sorts of other pressures on the new movie to succeed, and it’s likely that the loss of one producer might just be one of the smaller issues its production will need to contend with in the future. There are going to be even bigger potential issues down the line, so keep an eye on this one.

How are you feeling about Naruto ‘s live-action movie so far? Will Latcham’s exit make you worry about it? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments.

HT – THR
